title: Restriction of derived mapping presheaves to an etale scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let $B$ be a commutative ring, and let $K,L$ be objects of the derived category of etale $B$-module sheaves on $X$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $U$ be an etale $X$-scheme. Precompose each of the derived Hom and Isom presheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-derived-map-presheaves] on $X$ with the functor from the small etale site of $U$ to the small etale site of $X$ which composes structure maps with $U\to X$. The resulting presheaves are naturally isomorphic to the derived Hom and Isom presheaves of $K|_U,L|_U$, respectively. Restriction of objects is exact inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition].

source.place: Tags 094G lemma-locally-constant, 09BE lemma-locally-constant-map, and 08FR lemma-local-actual; Restriction of derived mapping presheaves to an etale scheme

proof.text: At an etale U-scheme V, the composition comparison for derived pullback identifies K restricted directly to V as an X-scheme with the pullback to V of K restricted to U. Conjugation by this comparison and the analogous comparison for L gives the bijections on Hom and Isom sets. Their inverses are conjugations by inverse comparisons.

Lift inverse-image associativity using a generic exact-functor calculation: mapDerivedCategoryNatIso preserves compositions, its whiskering comparisons are natural in both exact functors, and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso is associative. Apply this calculation to three etale pullbacks. The resulting comparison equation, followed by cancellation of inverse isomorphisms, proves naturality of conjugation on Hom sets. For Isom sets apply the same identity to their forward maps and use Iso.ext. Assemble both natural isomorphisms with NatIso.ofComponents.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_mapping_presheaves_restriction
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    (K L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (U : X.Etale) :
    Nonempty
      ((Scheme.Etale.etaleToOver U).op ⋙ (Over.forget U).op ⋙ derivedHomPresheaf B K L ≅
        derivedHomPresheaf B
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) U.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) U.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj L)) ∧
    Nonempty
      ((Scheme.Etale.etaleToOver U).op ⋙ (Over.forget U).op ⋙ derivedIsoPresheaf B K L ≅
        derivedIsoPresheaf B
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) U.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
          ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) U.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj L))
